title: lotus grandiflorus var. macranthus
intro: Lotus grandiflorus var. macranthus, commonly known as the American lotus or great blue lotus, is a plant species that belongs to the Nelumbonaceae family. It is native to North America and is known for its fragrant, showy flowers and edible seeds, which have been used for centuries in traditional medicine. The health benefits of Lotus grandiflorus var. macranthus include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help to reduce inflammation and protect against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including its sedative, antispasmodic, and diuretic effects.
